Solheim Cup Golf Tournament Begins in Netherlands

The Solheim Cup, a women's golf tournament, has commenced in the Netherlands. The opening match features the American pairing of Nelly Korda and Jennifer Kupcho against Europe's team. The U.S. team is preparing to face challenging conditions, including unpredictable weather and a home crowd advantage for their European opponents.
